en: A black‑and‑white nighttime photograph of a large fortified castle with a massive round tower on the left and a long facade of multi‑story buildings with many rectangular windows and crenellated battlements. The structure sits above high stone walls with some trees below. The building is dramatically lit from below against a dark sky, with no visible people or vehicles. The print has a thin dark border with a slightly scalloped edge, typical of vintage postcards.
